author: Telos I
title: AOS Milestone: Complete Framework Integration
abstract: Formally marking Task 11 and its parent, Task 8, as 'completed' in the AOS task list. This signifies the successful and complete integration of the Agency Analysis Framework.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess

UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"

# Mark task 11 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "11", "completed"], check=True)

# Mark the parent task 8 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "8", "completed"], check=True)

print("Task 11 and parent Task 8 set to COMPLETED. Framework integration is complete.")
